raw_document.title: ACME Pharma Reports Positive Phase 3 Results for AXD-101 in Moderate-to-Severe Psoriasis
raw_document.raw_text:
ACME Pharmaceuticals, Inc. today announced that the Phase 3 CLARITY trial of AXD-101 (axditinib) met its primary endpoint in patients with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis. The trial enrolled 842 patients across 112 sites in 18 countries.

Key Results:
- Primary endpoint: PASI 90 response at Week 16 achieved by 67.4% of patients treated with AXD-101 versus 8.2% on placebo (p<0.0001)
- Overall Response Rate (ORR): 52% (95% CI: 48.1-55.9%)
- Hazard ratio for sustained response: 0.72 (95% CI: 0.61-0.85)
- p-value for primary endpoint: 0.0001
- Safety profile consistent with Phase 2 findings; no new safety signals identified

The trial (NCT04567890) was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study. AXD-101 is a small molecule IL-17A inhibitor.

'These results represent a significant milestone for patients living with psoriasis,' said Dr. Jane Smith, Chief Medical Officer of ACME Pharma. 'We intend to submit a New Drug Application to the FDA in Q3 2024.'

ACME Pharma (NASDAQ: ACME) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on immune-mediated diseases.
